title: Hera A NDE 3447
content:
3447: I was on the operating table and noticed that my heart rate on the monitor changed to V-Tach. Suddenly I was sucked out of my body like a vacuum and saw the anesthesiologist calling my doctor who I saw in the parking garage. I saw that I was lying on the operating table, and then my body left the hospital and went into the universe, travelling very fast through space. I landed in a very cloudy place and the people I saw gathering around me were my dead patients that I had seen die when I worked in the intensive care unit. I thought to myself that I surely had died, for these people were dead. Then suddenly I saw my father who had died six months prior and he talked to me through my brain and led me to a tunnel. Before I approached the tunnel I was engulfed in a large ray of light, a light that was so beautiful and comforting and I felt unconditional love. While in the light I had a life review and saw everything I had ever done in my life, every thought, word, deed, action, inaction was shown to me. Then my father led me into this rotating tunnel, where at the end was a very beautiful garden. In the middle of the tunnel was a figure, who had his back to me. I was immediately thrown to my knees as my father stood next to me. My immediate thoughts moved to the Old Testament, where the Levites were attending the Arc of the Covenant, where the holy of holiness resided. I felt as if I were in this place and if the figure, who I thought was Jesus, turned around I would surely die. I heard three voices speak to me in unison. They said, 'You can stay or you can leave.' I remember when I heard this, I thought, 'I can stay or I can leave?' A part of me wanted to stay, yet another part of me wanted to leave. For I loved my father and he was next to me and I wanted to stay with him. I replied back to the voices, 'But I am not good enough to be here.' The most beautiful voice said to me, 'Oh, but you are.' I remember I was so humbled by this that even now when I think of it I cry. I kept trying to decide what to do, but could not make a decision. Suddenly, I felt a pulling on my shoulders as if something was pulling me back, and it was revealed to me that the pulling was the prayers of my mother and my children. I immediately, said, 'I gotta go,' and I shot out of that tunnel so fast, hearing like a vacuum sound. I shot back through the universe and awoke looking at the doctor who told me that I was going to die. I told the doctor that I had been in heaven and that I was not going to die. When I saw my mother, I immediately started to cry and told her that I had seen my father. I ended up having five surgeries that year and survived.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: “sucked out of my body like a vacuum”

arrival.religious_figure_detail: In the tunnel was a figure with his back turned; experiencer “thought was Jesus.”
arrival.other_being_detail: “three voices speak to me in unison.” Also saw “dead patients that I had seen die.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “very cloudy place”; “at the end was a very beautiful garden.”

person_demographics.occupation: Worked in an intensive care unit (ICU).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Travel “into the universe… through space”; “dead patients… gathering around me”; “three voices speak… in unison.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE followed by rapid travel through space to a “cloudy place,” then encounter with deceased (patients and father), then light/life review, then tunnel/garden and boundary/choice, then rapid return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Encountered “dead patients that I had seen die” (from ICU work). Perceived return-pull as “the prayers of my mother and my children.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly I was sucked out of my body like a vacuum.” “Before I approached the tunnel I was engulfed in a large ray of light… unconditional love.” “You can stay or you can leave.” “But I am not good enough to be here.” “Oh, but you are.” “I gotta go.”
